description:
`crates/gf2-sim/src/permanent_campaign/validation.rs` still admits continuation of the producer-0 schema-1 run state. Schema-2 receipts need only the read-only decoder of that state as evidence; the executable admission path is a superseded representation under `@/inv/canonical-cutover`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No code path resumes or continues a producer-0 schema-1 run state.
- [hard] REQ-02: The read-only decoder `FrozenProducer0RunStateV1Evidence` and its content-identity check remain, and every committed schema-2 receipt that cites the state still verifies, covered by the existing validation tests.
title: Remove producer-0 continuation admission from permanent campaign validation
